title: Example message broker is above its memory threshold

unsupported.reason: This alarm fires on a broker memory metric. There is no log group carrying the evidence, so no log analysis can reach a verdict.
manualSteps: Open the broker's memory metric graph for the alarm window.
Compare consumer lag against the runbook's recorded baseline.
Escalate to the owning team with both graphs if the trend is not recovering.

followUps: Capture the verdict in the incident record.
